title: Learning smooth dynamics via Kinematic Interpolants
abstract: arXiv:2610.22519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inferring dynamics from real-world experimental data is inherently ambiguous, as many plausible dynamical systems can explain the same positional observations at measurement times. For higher fidelity modeling of applications ranging from single-cell RNA to vortex dynamics and even flocking of birds, scientific observables increasingly also include velocity estimates that serve to resolve this issue. However, incorporating this rich information in a scalable manner, free of simulation or unnecessary approximations, has remained a difficult challenge. In this paper, we introduce Kinematic Interpolants (KI), a novel framework that extends the seminal methodology of stochastic interpolants to infer nonlinear dynamics across multiple snapshots in phase space, i.e., observables with position and velocity measurements. translated_title: 基于运动学插值子学习光滑动力学
translated_abstract: 从真实世界的实验数据中推断动力学本质上是模糊的，因为许多合理的动力系统都可以解释在测量时刻所获得的相同位置观测数据。为了对从单细胞RNA到涡旋动力学乃至鸟群集群等各类应用进行更高保真度的建模，科学观测量日益包含有助于解决这一歧义问题的速度估计信息。然而，如何以可扩展的方式、且无需模拟或不必要的近似来融入这些丰富的信息，一直是一个困难的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了运动学插值子，这是一个新颖的框架，它将开创性的随机插值方法加以扩展，以在相空间的多个快照（即同时包含位置和速度测量的观测量）之间推断非线性动力学。在实验上，我们证明在多个科学数据集上，KI 实现了对潜在动力学的卓越重建。
tldr: 该论文提出运动学插值子（KI）框架，将随机插值方法扩展至包含位置与速度测量的相空间多快照数据，从而无需模拟即可可扩展地高保真重建潜在的非线性动力学。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Kinematic Interpolants (KI), a novel framework that extends stochastic interpolants to infer nonlinear dynamics from multiple phase-space snapshots with both position and velocity measurements, enabling scalable, simulation-free reconstruction of smooth underlying dynamics.
